_doc: Reviewed registry of every params.fields key a COMPOSER consumes.
tools/composer_param_lint.py errors on any composer-consumed key not
registered here — so adding one forces the question this registry
encodes: is the key MUSIC or MECHANISM, and which ledger entry / canon
musical-content    — the value IS music (a contour, a fade formula);
the model can learn it; preferred (C1/C10/C14).
mechanism-knob     — reproduces a per-member player mechanism the
write stream demands (C19 wedges etc.). Each is
a standing DECONSTRUCTION candidate; note it.
temporal-dispatch  — WHEN play runs, not what it plays (C18/C24/C31).
A key a musician could not read that is NOT a mechanism demanded by
the write stream is the principle-section-8 leak in param clothing.
